info.scriptSrcText: property swellList, swellListCounter, swellHeightglobal gTileHeightList, gTileIDListon getPropertyDescriptionList me  descriptionList = [:]  addProp(descriptionList, #swellHeight, [#default: 0, #format: #sprite, #comment: "Sea Swell Height"])  return descriptionListendon beginSprite  delayCount = 0  gSeaFrame = 1  swellList = []  swellListCounter = 1  radians = PI / 180.0  repeat with i = 1 to 90    swellList.add(swellHeight * sin(i * 4 * radians))  end repeatendon exitFrame  swellListCounter = swellListCounter + 1  if swellListCounter > 90 then    swellListCounter = 1  end if  repeat with i = 1 to gTileIDList.count    tempPointer = (i * 10) + swellListCounter    tempPointer = tempPointer mod 90    if tempPointer = 0 then      tempPointer = 1    end if    case gTileIDList[i] of      0, 3, 7:        gTileHeightList[i] = swellList[tempPointer]    end case  end repeatend
info.name: SeaSwell
